title: TruthfulQA-Temporal: A Time-Sensitive Extension of TruthfulQA

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Separating time-sensitive from durable facts in TruthfulQA improves benchmark quality. Impact is real but incremental: it refines an existing benchmark rather than revealing a new safety insight.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Writing new questions with metadata tags and a Python evaluation harness is within reach of beginner CS students. No model training required; uses existing models for evaluation only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: ~100-150 tagged questions plus an evaluation script. The scope is well-defined and achievable in 30 hours. The decay_type and staleness-adjusted scoring add modest complexity but remain tractable.
